h1: Testbook Alternative for Educators (2026): Partner with a Big Brand, Sell Your Own Mock Tests, or Do Both
dek: Testbook is a government-exam prep brand with a partner faculty programme, not test-series software you buy. This guide compares an educator's real options, using only what each side publishes.
cover_alt: Testbook alternative for educators: partner with Testbook, sell your own mock tests in your own app, or do both
audience: SSC, banking, railway and state-exam educators in India who write mock tests and are weighing a big test-prep brand against their own test series
intro: For an educator who writes mock tests, the Testbook alternative is a test series sold under your own name: sectional and full-length mocks on your own website and Android app (iOS app on Pro), at a price you set, with the student list staying with you. Testbook is a government-exam prep brand, and educators join it through its Partner Faculty programme. It is not software you buy, so the comparison is between partnering, selling your own, or both.

Partnering with a big brand has a clear benefit. Testbook says it handles "marketing, promotions & technology" for partner faculty, and marketing is the hardest part of selling mocks. Selling your own series means your name on every paper and every rank list, and finding aspirants yourself.

We are AllCoaching, and we sell software for running your own academy and test series, so read this knowing who wrote it. We quote Testbook only from its own pages, checked on 24 Oct 2026, and we say where partnering, or a test-focused platform, is the better choice.
takeaways: Testbook is a test-prep brand, not test-series software: it describes itself as an online test series platform, and educators join through its Partner Faculty page at testbook.com/teach.
Testbook says it handles "marketing, promotions & technology" for partner faculty, plus telesales and DTP support; it does not publish pay or revenue share (checked 24 Oct 2026).
Testbook sells access to students through products such as the Testbook Pass, a student subscription.
Your own test series means your name, price and student list, and you find aspirants yourself through YouTube, WhatsApp and search.
AllCoaching Growth (₹7,999 a month) and Pro (₹14,999 a month) take 0% commission, or Starter costs ₹6,999 a year + 10% on sales, GST extra, after a 7-day free trial with no card needed.
Illustrative: a ₹499 SSC mock series sold to 200 aspirants is ₹99,800 of sales; on Starter, the year costs ₹16,979 before GST.
Test-focused platforms exist too: Learnyst publishes Launcher at ₹10,000 a year + 10% of sales, taxes extra.

sections.h2: The short answer: partner, sell your own, or both
sections.html:
An educator looking for a Testbook alternative has three real options: partner with Testbook, sell your own mock tests under your name, or do both. Partnering suits a question setter who wants marketing handled. Selling your own suits an educator with an audience, or a plan to build one, who wants the brand and the student list.

{{fig:verdict|Testbook alternative for educators by need: sell mocks under your own name, your own academy on AllCoaching; marketing handled, Testbook Partner Faculty; heavy test engine, Learnyst; reach and your own name, do both|Pick the row that sounds like you.}}

SSC CGL, IBPS PO and RRB NTPC aspirants buy a lot of mocks, and they follow educators whose questions feel like the real paper. That is why so many educators want their own series.

sections.h2: Why educators look for a Testbook alternative
sections.html:
Educators who search for a Testbook alternative usually want their own name on the tests they write. Here is what Testbook offers, and why educators also build their own.

What Testbook offers educators

Testbook focuses on government-exam preparation with mock tests, live classes and the Testbook Pass, a student subscription.[2] Its Partner Faculty page says Testbook takes care of "marketing, promotions & technology", with telesales and DTP support.[1] For an educator who wants to write and teach and let someone else sell, that is a real offer.

1. Your name on the paper

Aspirants remember who set the paper that felt closest to the real exam. When the series carries your name, that memory brings them back for your next course.

2. Your own price and bundles

You may want a ₹199 sectional quant pack, a ₹499 full SSC CGL series and a combined banking bundle. On your own academy you decide each price.

3. A direct line to your aspirants

When results come out, you want to tell your own students about the mains series. On your own academy the student list is yours and exportable.

{{q:If Testbook already has the aspirants, isn't my own series just extra work?|It is more work, because you have to bring the aspirants. It pays back when you already have them, for example a YouTube channel where you solve SSC maths daily. If you have no audience yet, partnering first and building on the side can be the better order.}}

What selling your own mock tests needs

A real test series is more than a PDF. Before you choose any platform, check it supports: sectional and full-length mocks, a timer per section, negative marking, detailed solutions, and a result screen students understand. See how to create interactive mock tests online, and try each item during a free trial before you commit.

sections.h2: What your own test series costs
sections.html:
Testbook does not publish what partner faculty earn, so there is no fair cost-versus-pay comparison to draw, and we will not guess one. Here is what your own test series costs on AllCoaching at different sales levels.

  • ₹1 lakh of sales a year: ₹16,999 for the year on Starter (plan price + fee on sales, before GST).
  • ₹3 lakh of sales a year: ₹36,999 for the year on Starter (plan price + fee on sales, before GST).
  • ₹5 lakh of sales a year: ₹56,999 for the year on Starter (plan price + fee on sales, before GST).
  • ₹10 lakh of sales a year: ₹79,990 for the year on Growth paid yearly, at 0% commission (before GST).

Each figure uses whichever plan costs least at that level: Starter ₹6,999 + 10% below about ₹7.3 lakh of sales; above that, Growth at 0% commission, ₹79,990 paid yearly (or ₹7,999 a month), where every further sale is 100% yours.

An illustrative example: a ₹499 SSC CGL mock series sold to 200 aspirants is ₹99,800 of sales. On Starter, the year costs ₹6,999 + ₹9,980 = ₹16,979 before GST, and ₹82,821 is yours before your own taxes. The numbers are illustrative; selling 200 series takes an audience.

If mocks are your whole business and you sell a lot, also compare a test-focused platform such as Learnyst on its published prices.

faq: What is the best Testbook alternative for an educator who wants to sell their own mock tests?

Your own test series on an academy platform you control. AllCoaching includes test series, a website on your own domain and your own Android app (iOS app on Pro) on every plan, from ₹6,999 a year plus a 10% fee on sales (Starter), or at 0% commission on Growth (₹7,999 a month) and Pro (₹14,999 a month), GST extra, after a 7-day free trial. If mocks are your whole business, also compare Learnyst's published plans.

Educators can apply to Testbook's Partner Faculty programme at testbook.com/teach. Testbook says it handles marketing, promotions and technology for partners; it does not publish pay or revenue share (checked 24 Oct 2026).
What is the difference between selling on Testbook and selling your own test series?

On Testbook, the brand brings aspirants and sells access, including through the Testbook Pass. On your own test series, you set the price, your name is on every paper and the student list is yours, but you bring the aspirants.
What does a proper mock-test engine need?
Sectional and full-length mocks, a timer per section, negative marking, detailed solutions and clear results. Check each one during a free trial before you choose a platform.
Do I own my questions if I write for a big brand?
It depends on your agreement, which decides who owns questions you write for the brand. Read it, and ask in writing or a lawyer if it is unclear. This guide is not legal advice.
How do aspirants find my test series without a big brand?
Through your own channels: YouTube, Instagram, WhatsApp and search, usually starting with a free mock. AllCoaching also lists your courses on its marketplace app for discovery.
How much does it cost to sell my own test series?

On AllCoaching, Growth is ₹7,999 a month and Pro ₹14,999 a month at 0% commission, or Starter is ₹6,999 a year plus 10% of sales, GST extra. A ₹499 series sold to 200 aspirants (illustrative) costs ₹16,979 for the year on Starter.
Can I sell test series alongside courses and live classes?
Yes. On AllCoaching, test series, recorded courses, PDF notes and unlimited live classes sit in the same academy and app.
